settingsFeedback.analysisHelp: Turning this off stops new automatic model analyses, triage and translations. News, prices and portfolio data keep refreshing. A running call finishes; manual analyses remain available.
settingsFeedback.batchTitle: Analysis batch · preview and manual run

email.title: Email notifications
email.configured: SMTP connection is configured on the server.
email.unconfigured: SMTP is not configured yet. You can save recipients; delivery stays off.
email.recipientsHelp: One address per line or separated by commas; up to 20 recipients.
email.security: The SMTP password is configured on the server only and never shown here. Saving does not send a test message.
email.error: Could not save. Check addresses and SMTP setup; reload after a concurrent change.
email.uncertain: {count} deliveries have an uncertain result. They are not retried automatically; check the mail server.

processHelp.radar: Collects news and finds events. Model analysis and translations follow the master switch; news collection continues.
processHelp.entries: Checks entry points and reasons for declines. Automatic model work follows the master switch.
processHelp.discover_thesis_reviews: Discovers and reviews theses. Model reviews follow the master switch.
processHelp.batch_analyses: Prepares a limited batch for the portfolio or watchlist. Preview and quota checks precede starting.
processHelp.sync_flex: Reads portfolio and trades from IBKR. Uses no language model.
processHelp.refresh_bars: Refreshes daily instrument prices. Uses no language model.
processHelp.fundamentals: Refreshes company fundamentals from the data provider.
processHelp.outcomes: Calculates saved signal outcomes from prices. Requires no new analysis.
processHelp.notify: Sends existing signal notifications through Telegram.
processHelp.digest: Builds a Telegram digest from saved signals.
processHelp.refresh_etf_profiles: Refreshes fund profiles from the data provider.
